Scene / Preset Tools - V1.34
  These are performance shortcuts built from the validated four-lane system.
  They do not introduce new parameter ranges; they call the existing safe global layer.

Scene commands:
  SCN = show this scene / preset menu
  S0  = Home / Clean anchors
  S1  = Rolling scene
  S1A = Rolling Light
  S1B = Rolling Push
  S2  = Deeper scene
  S2A = Deeper Groove
  S2B = Deeper Pressure
  S3  = Intense scene
  S3A = Intense Motion
  S3B = Intense Grit
  S4  = Wild scene
  S4A = Wild Controlled
  S4B = Wild Maximum
  S5  = Back to Clean anchors

Scene behavior:
  SCN only displays this menu/status; it does not send MIDI or load anchors.
  S0 loads the full four-pad anchor state if needed, or returns all pads to anchors if already loaded.
  S1-S4 and S1A-S4B now auto-load the four-pad anchors first if needed, then run the scene.
  S5 returns all four pads to the validated anchors.

Current scene:
  None
  Four-pad state: not loaded yet. This is normal before O, S0, or the first scene command.

Global 4-Pad Mutation Tools - V1.34
  These commands now respect the validated four-lane system.

Performance lanes:
  Pad 1 = protected BD Hard kick foundation
  Pad 2 = secondary percussion / snare lane
  Pad 3 = SY Raw bass / synth-percussion motion lane
  Pad 4 = BD Acoustic body / accent pressure lane

Commands:
  X = balanced four-lane mutation
  D = deeper four-lane mutation
  I = intense / controlled chaos four-lane mutation
  4 = harder / wild discovery four-lane mutation
  Y = lane-aware SRC/morph mutation, choose depth
  V = lane-aware filter mutation, choose depth
  N = lane-aware grit mutation, choose depth
  Z = return all 4 pads to anchors

Behavior guardrails:
  X keeps Pad 1 stable and gives movement mostly to Pads 2-4.
  D pushes Pads 2-4 harder while protecting the kick foundation.
  I uses Pad 3 as the main chaos/motion carrier.
  4 is the wildest option but still keeps Pad 1 bounded.
  Y maps Pad 3 to morph instead of full raw SRC for more musical movement.
